name: Implement cold-start rebuild from PGlite into Valkey
description: Replace the current manual/simulated rebuild with PGlite-derived rebuild. Scan non-terminal PGlite rows (enqueue_pending, in_progress, retry_scheduled), derive the Valkey structures that should exist (stream entries, sorted set members, TTL keys), and emit recovery receipts. Must not rebuild completed, failed-terminal, cancelled, or dead-lettered work. Must be idempotent and run in under 1 second.
